description: Compare a FixMap plan with the git diff produced after editing. Flags unplanned files, missing test changes, new risk areas, and generated artifacts. Provide the JSON report returned by fixmap_plan plus diff or base/head, and run against a local checkout.

base.description: Base git ref when diff is omitted

diff.description: Git diff spec, such as main...HEAD

format.description: Output format: markdown (default) or json, case-insensitive

head.description: Head git ref, defaults to HEAD

noCache.description: Bypass the exact-state repository scan cache

repo.description: Local repository path, defaults to the server working directory

report.description: The FixMap report to verify against, either as the JSON object returned by fixmap_plan or as a path to a local JSON report file such as "./fixmap-report.json". Prefer the path when the plan is large.

workingTree.description: Verify staged and unstaged tracked changes against HEAD

name: fixmap_verify
title: FixMap verify
